Careers / Analytics / Data Analyst

Data Analyst

Contoso Health is looking for a Data Analyst to join its clinical analytics group in Springfield.

Responsibilities

  • Build weekly reports on patient wait times using SQL and Power BI.
  • Work with nurses and administrators to define the metrics that matter.
  • Keep data dictionaries and report documentation current.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics or a related field.
  • Two years of experience writing SQL against a relational database.

This is an onsite role. Salary: $70,000 - $82,000 per year.
